description: Golden fixtures for ownership transfer acceptance and expiry (#1123).

OwnershipTransferNotFound.description: accept/cancel/expire called with no pending transfer record.

OwnershipTransferExpired.description: Acceptance attempted after the expires_at ledger sequence.

ownership_expired.description: Emitted when expire_ownership_transfer cleans up a stale record.

PendingOwner.lifecycle: created by propose_ownership_transfer; deleted by accept, cancel, or expire
PendingOwner.description: Exists only while a two-phase transfer is pending. Absence means no transfer is in progress.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: ownership_expiry_exact_boundary_success
rare_failure_fixtures.description: Accepting at ledger == expires_at is still valid (boundary inclusive).

rare_failure_fixtures.name: ownership_expiry_one_past
rare_failure_fixtures.description: Accepting at ledger == expires_at + 1 must return OwnershipTransferExpired.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: expire_before_deadline
rare_failure_fixtures.description: expire_ownership_transfer before expires_at must return InvalidAction.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: expire_at_exact_deadline
rare_failure_fixtures.description: expire_ownership_transfer at ledger == expires_at must return InvalidAction (not yet past).

rare_failure_fixtures.name: expire_one_past_deadline
rare_failure_fixtures.description: expire_ownership_transfer at ledger == expires_at + 1 must succeed.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: accept_after_cancel
rare_failure_fixtures.description: After cancel_ownership_transfer, any accept attempt returns OwnershipTransferNotFound.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: ttl_beyond_max
rare_failure_fixtures.description: propose with ttl > OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_MAX_TTL (17_280*90) must return InvalidAction.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: accept_no_proposal
rare_failure_fixtures.description: accept_ownership_transfer with no pending record returns OwnershipTransferNotFound.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: cancel_no_proposal
rare_failure_fixtures.description: cancel_ownership_transfer with no pending record returns OwnershipTransferNotFound.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: non_admin_propose
rare_failure_fixtures.description: An address that is not Pool.admin cannot propose a transfer.

rare_failure_fixtures.name: wrong_acceptor
rare_failure_fixtures.description: An address other than proposed_owner cannot accept.
